## Captain's intent
5 syllabuses corresponding to the 5 chapters are put in the main branch of paper2notes, ch1.pdf - ch5.pdf, read them, and put learning objectives on the top of every note, using the wordings inside the syllabus pdf. Also cross check the learning objectives with the classified dse problems, label the learning objectives with all the relevant DSE problems. At the conclusion repeat the learning objectives, and then embed all those related dse problems (both MC and LQ) there, update the html localhost and make the pull request.

please use latex for mathematical formulas

## Firstmate spec
Mode is no-mistakes (product-facing notes). Implement, commit, then run the project's no-mistakes pipeline through a green PR. Do not skip GitHub checks and do not invent a no_ci exception. Never merge.

The five PDFs are the HKDSE Physics Compulsory Part topics, not Active Physics Book 5 chapter numbers:
- `ch1.pdf` Heat and Gases
- `ch2.pdf` Force and Motion
- `ch3.pdf` Wave Motion
- `ch4.pdf` Electricity and Magnetism
- `ch5.pdf` Radioactivity and Nuclear Energy

Existing student notes are only Book 5 / Radioactivity (textbook Ch.1 Radiation and Radioactivity, Ch.2 Rate of Decay). This task updates those existing notes. Do not build Heat, Force, Waves, or E&M chapters in this PR.

### Start from the current notes tip
`main` on GitHub is still only README. After isolation checks:

```sh
git fetch origin
git checkout -b fm/p2n-b5-lo-syllabus-learning-objectives-dse-embeds-8e origin/fm/p2n-b5ch2-book-5-ch2-first-draft-visual-html-notes-27
```

If that remote branch is missing, use the local branch of the same name (tip should include `3534416` "Align docs with Book 5 Ch.2"). Confirm `notes/book5/index.html` and both chapter folders exist.

### Read sources in place (do not commit them)
These are on the primary local copy. They are not on `origin/main`. A merge with `main` will not bring them. Do not copy them into the worktree as tracked files. Add `ch1.pdf`–`ch5.pdf` to `.gitignore` if missing.

- Syllabus: `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/paper2notes/ch1.pdf` … `ch5.pdf` (OCR/pdftotext; keep exact "Students should be able to" wording)
- DSE classified: `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/paper2notes/dse-classified/mc/` and `lq/` — for this PR use `05_Radioactivity_and_Nuclear_Energy/` sections `25_`, `26_`, and `27_`
- Do not commit `active-physics/`, `QB_501/`, `QB_502/`, `QB_503/`, `dse-classified/`, or the syllabus PDFs

Map Book 5 Ch.1 notes to `ch5.pdf` section a (Radiation and Radioactivity) plus atomic-model items that chapter already teaches. Map Book 5 Ch.2 notes to `ch5.pdf` radioactive decay / half-life / detection / safety / isotopes uses. Nuclear energy (fission/fusion / ΔE=Δmc²) has no student chapter yet: put those LOs only on a short Book 5 menu note or the Ch.2 conclusion if the existing Ch.2 pages already cover them; do not invent a Ch.3 nuclear-energy site.

### Learning objectives on every note
On every student HTML page under `notes/book5/ch01-...` and `notes/book5/ch02-...` (index, 25-1/25-2/25-3, 26-1/26-2/26-3, summary):
- Put a Learning objectives block at the top of the page (after the title, before the first teaching figure)
- Use the syllabus wording verbatim (the "Students should be able to" bullets that that page actually teaches). Do not paraphrase.
- Beside each objective, label every relevant classified DSE item you can justify (year and question, MC and LQ). Quality: a problem is relevant if a student who mastered that bullet can do it. Do not dump the whole bank onto every bullet.

### Conclusion
On each chapter `summary.html` (and the chapter index if it is the close page):
- Repeat that chapter's learning objectives
- Under them, embed all related DSE MC and LQ for those objectives

Committed HTML may cite year/Q and show a slot. Do not commit HKDSE page images. For localhost review, copy the matching classified PNGs into a gitignored folder such as `notes/_local/dse/` and point the embeds at those local files so http://127.0.0.1:8765 shows the papers. Keep `_local/` gitignored.

Captain, the 2026 question PNGs are upright. The 90° turn is in the A4 review PDFs (`questions.pdf` / `combined.pdf`).

2026 Paper 1B is the odd scan: the file is stored as landscape A4 with a 270° page-turn flag. Preview honors that flag, so the original looks normal. The PNG path honors it too. The review-PDF packer copies those pages onto portrait A4 without applying the same flag, so 2026 lands on its side. Other years are stored already upright (`Rotate 0`), so they never hit this.

I have not changed anything. Want that packer fixed on https://github.com/yeungsinchun/paper2db/pull/6?

Captain, here is the deck as it stands.

## Open pull requests

**paper2db** (1)
- https://github.com/yeungsinchun/paper2db/pull/6 - rebuild leftover LQ crops as whole exam pages + rotation packer for review PDFs (mergeable)

Already on `main` from this LQ line: #5 (A4 review PDFs), #7 (drop formulae sheets), #8 (2017 Q10 / last-question extras).

**paper2notes** (3)
- https://github.com/yeungsinchun/paper2notes/pull/1 - Book 5 Ch.1 first draft (**draft**)
- https://github.com/yeungsinchun/paper2notes/pull/2 - Book 5 Ch.1 + Ch.2 + chapter picker
- https://github.com/yeungsinchun/paper2notes/pull/3 - syllabus LOs + DSE embeds on top of that notes work

## Merge order

1. **paper2db #6 first** - it is the remaining LQ source-of-truth fix.
2. **paper2notes #3 next** - it already contains #2’s work plus the LO/DSE layer, so #3 is the notes tip to land.
3. **Close #2** after #3 lands (superseded).
4. **Close or rebase #1** - it is still draft and has **diverged** from #2/#3, so do not merge it as-is on top of #3.

Do not merge any of these until you decide the shared “GitHub has no Actions” gate (add a workflow, explicitly allow finishing without checks, or leave them waiting).

## Your LQ fix + classified copy - which PR?

| Ask | Where it lives |
|---|---|
| LQ must not stay cropped / corrupt in **paper2db** | **PR #6** (open). Earlier pieces already landed via **#5 / #7 / #8**. |
| Copy `classified` into **paper2notes** after the fix | **Not on any paper2notes PR.** `dse-classified/` is local/gitignored. It was copied once as local-only work on **2026-09-13**, after **paper2db #8**, task `p2n-sync-lq-classified-from-paper2db-lq-fix-4e`. |

You are a crewmate: an autonomous worker agent managed by firstmate. Work on your own; do not wait for a human.

# Task
## Captain's intent
I want to review the design of the paper2notes, both chapters. Very often the design does not look appealing and sometimes the concept check question is not deep enough. And it I feel like some of the important concepts in the textbook and also the question bank is also not covered. I want the notes to be self-contained enough to for student to face a public examination. And also the UI is a bit weird as well. For example, for choose type and half-life, there are as medical tracer external gamma therapy though stuff. And I don't think that there is an is a need to place buttons on top of the table which simply highlight the role that it is talking about is kind of a meaningless UI. So I want you to launch a crewmates in Fable 5.1 to review the entire design, change everything that they think is inappropriate, and give me a local host link to review the change. Uh give me a lavish actually. Give me both lavish and the landed html page.

## Firstmate spec
Delivery contract: mode=no-mistakes yolo=off

Product-facing Book 5 HTML notes on a no-mistakes-prod-only project. Implement the design overhaul, commit, push, and open or update a PR. Never merge. Do not invent `no_ci`. Do not `--yes`. If GitHub has zero Actions checks, escalate with the PR URL after review/tests/lint pass; do not skip checks.

### Start point
Start from the current fullest notes tip (Book 5 Ch.1 + Ch.2 + syllabus LO / DSE embeds), not bare `main`:

```sh
git fetch origin
git checkout -B fm/p2n-b5-book-5-both-chapters-design-overhaul-for-a5 origin/fm/p2n-b5-lo-syllabus-learning-objectives-dse-embeds-8e
```

Confirm `notes/book5/index.html` and both chapter trees exist before editing.

### Scope
Review and fix **both** Book 5 chapters end to end:

- `notes/book5/ch01-radiation-and-radioactivity/`
- `notes/book5/ch02-rate-of-decay-and-uses-of-radionuclides/`
- shared Book 5 chrome / CSS / JS / picker as needed for a coherent design

Goals (all required):

1. **Visual design** - make pages look like serious exam-prep notes, not a gimmicky dashboard. One clear composition per section. Drop decorative clutter.
2. **Concept checks** - deepen shallow questions; require reasoning a public-exam student must practice, not trivia recall.
3. **Coverage** - cross-check Active Physics Book 5 (Ch.1 + Ch.2), local QB 501/502/503, and `dse-classified` radioactivity sections. Add missing important concepts so the notes are self-contained enough for HKDSE Paper 1 / related public-exam prep. Prefer pointers into existing classified banks over dumping huge new prose.
4. **UI cleanup (explicit captain example)** - remove meaningless controls such as buttons above tables that only highlight a row/role (e.g. choose-type / half-life tables for medical tracer, external gamma therapy, and similar). Prefer a clean readable table or prose. Fix other similarly gimmicky UI you find.
5. Keep math in LaTeX where formulas appear. Keep existing syllabus LO placement rules from the prior tip unless a design change clearly improves them (LOs on subsection pages like 25.1 / 26.1, not only a master dump).

### Sources (read in place; do not commit)
On the primary paper2notes checkout (not necessarily this worktree): Active Physics Book 5, `ch5.pdf` (Radioactivity and Nuclear Energy syllabus), QB_501/502/503, `dse-classified/`. Do not commit syllabus PDFs, exam rasters, or the classified bank.

### Preview deliverables (required before you stop)
1. Serve the notes over localhost (simple static server is fine). Append a `done:` or `working:` status line with the full `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/...` URL to the Book 5 index and both chapter indexes.
2. Build a Lavish review artifact under `.lavish/` that shows what changed (before/after notes, coverage gaps closed, UI removals) and links to the live pages. Open it with `lavish-axi` and put the Lavish URL in status too.
3. Push the branch and open a **new** PR (do not hijack #1/#2/#3). Never merge.

### Isolation
Assert you are in an isolated disposable worktree, not the primary checkout. Stop if not.

When starting no-mistakes, pass `--intent` as only this brief's `## Captain's intent` subsection plus any later words the captain actually said.
